Name: Cremator Native Flame v0.4.0
Description: Requires Bingus Shared Loader v16 / API 1. Game 1.8.46015.0. Choose ONE option; replaces previous combined Cremator mod.

SubOptions.Name: A — Native flame range + 4/4 / 原生火焰延程＋4/4
SubOptions.Description: User-tested native flame extension, unchanged from v0.3.0. Shared Fire damage 4/4 also affects Flame Sentry and EXO-51.

SubOptions.Name: B — Sentry flame range + 3/3 / 炮塔火焰射程＋3/3（平衡版）
SubOptions.Description: Reuses v0.2.0 RangeOnly behavior: sentry/Lumberer flame effect, original shared 3/3 damage. Prior low damage and close-range/visual limitations retained.

SubOptions.Name: C — Native range + 3/3 + BurningHeavy / 原生火焰延程＋3/3＋重度燃烧
SubOptions.Description: Same native flame extension. Direct damage stays 3/3; preserves Fire and all existing statuses, adds BurningHeavy (type 32, application value 2) in the empty fourth slot. Shared with Flame Sentry and EXO-51. New option requires gameplay testing.
